overview: At home the three sentences were already dry. Under them you wrote send for a glass. You did not strike the line. The margin stayed empty. There was no glass in the room. The ink is on your finger.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the order under the three sentences and left the margin empty.
